integrity: Standalone source programs, reference outputs, and exact optimum/exchange lists are included. Graphs are constructed from two independent presentations. Reproduction requires Python 3 standard library only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite Pappus incidence graph; the complete minimum and exchange geometry are established by exact finite enumeration in addition to the analytic affine-triangle classification; no statement for all finite incidence structures. Numerical maximal-matching counts may be available through graph-software tables. Prior published or unindexed equivalent exchange results cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Affine triangles and a sharp three-edge exchange threshold for Pappus minimum maximal matchings
